published.citation: Ellis et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 97658 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive: 5212 +/- 43 K, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..118E/abstract

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 97658 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), so the colour is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
